rationale: The image shows a person on a pebble beach carrying a long white paddleboard horizontally under one arm while holding an upright paddle, with a pier carrying funfair structures on the left. B correctly describes the board as carried horizontally at waist height. It also notes the thin vertical pole (the paddle), the leash hanging near one end and the small logo near the tail, all of which match the image. A wrongly says the board is held upright and vertical with its nose toward the sea, a clear attribute error, and it misses the paddle. Both describe the pier with its white building, metal framework and tall mast reasonably; neither identifies the fairground rides explicitly. B is more accurate and precise.
